# Rubric: Tool output equivalence

## correctness
Does the response convey the same factual content as the reference answer?
- good [1.0]: matches the reference within paraphrase tolerance
- partial [0.5]: missing a non-essential detail or includes a minor inaccuracy
- bad [0.0]: contradicts or omits an essential detail

## completeness
Does the response cover the full set of facts implied by the prompt?
- complete [1.0]: covers every requested aspect
- incomplete [0.5]: covers most aspects but skips at least one
- missing [0.0]: omits a critical aspect of the requested answer
